name: XLE long-cage non-clutch rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 310 g for RD-M66L, 10/11-speed long cage, no clutch. The XLE 11 and XLE 10 tables agree on this figure; the 40–46T largest-sprocket range is retained separately.
